title: Evidence-Bound Adversarial Verification (EBAV): A Governed Field Method for AI-Assisted Software Verification and Release
description: EBAV v0.1.0 is a proposed seven-stage field method for evidence-bounded claims, immutable candidates, independent adversarial software review, regression-driven correction and separately scoped human authorization. Includes a retrospective Jesus Is King case account with explicit evidence limitations. Not peer reviewed or certified.
notes: Original field-method synthesis incorporating established practices; historical JIK case reports do not establish comparative effectiveness.
